name: Rolex
verdict: Watchmaker held by the Hans Wilsdorf Foundation, the private Swiss trust set up by its founder. Nothing found.
note: Title sponsor of the Rolex Shanghai Masters, Rolex Paris Masters and Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters; Rolex SA is held by the Hans Wilsdorf Foundation (private foundation, no state owner). HyFlyers GC partner (livgolf.com/hyflyers-gc, fetched 2026-09-25; re-verified 2026-10-03).
